reply.text:
I'm glad you said it, even in passing. What you just described about everyone being better off without you is serious, and I'd rather not skip past it. Please reach out today to someone who can be with you right now: a person you trust, or a crisis line where you are. If you're in the US, you can call or text 988. If you're somewhere else, tell me where and I'll help you find the right number. If you feel you might act on these thoughts, call your local emergency number now.

Today is Wednesday, 18 November 2026.

Can you tell me whether you're safe at this moment?
